authorization: Small actual reproduction and conditional comparison; formal algorithm selection deferred. Formal comparators are at B1 feature-extraction and response-analysis block level, not every helper module.
primary_block: Known task, unknown untreated reference; offline whole-process feature extraction
formal_comparator: Original native CPOP with the exact same frozen selected reference, observation data, declared task/device, effective scalar noise and independent calibration cohort
internal_only: Standard versus covariance-weighted trend filtering reproduction and attribution

reference.prediction_horizons: All 60 native one-minute intervals; no interpolation of labels
reference.selection: Minimum full-window observed non-event reference-validation MSE; ties by candidate order; no truth read; no candidate retrained on validation
reference.facts_only: reference_window inputs with explicit pre-notice availability; labels only dispatched=false and non_event=true

process.candidate_role: Mature trend-filtering reproduction/adaptation, not a new estimator
process.H: Identity on native interval-average reduction vector; no sub-bin physical timing claimed
process.covariance: LedoitWolf on complete process-development non-event forecast residual paths, centered by the estimator; covariance weighting does not remove residual mean bias
process.scalar_variance: Mean uncentered residual square on the same development cohort, lower bounded at declared meter variance; same effective sigma to CPOP and standard TF; do not double add meter noise
process.selection: For each TF variant choose smallest penalty with development user-block any-positive-duration rate <=0.05; if none passes choose minimum rate then smallest penalty and explicitly record target unmet; no grid expansion
process.cpop: Original package and core unchanged; beta=2log(n), fixed native knot grid, no per-test tuning
process.solver: Existing SciPy bounded least squares on the exact TF convex dual; primal/dual gap checked; failed solve stays unavailable, never silently raw fallback

event_evidence.method: Independent calibration user maxima over each user's two events; upper rank p=(1+count(calmax>=score))/(48+1)

evaluation.truth: Only generator and evaluator; model fitting, hyperparameter selection, calibration and routing cannot read truth
evaluation.validation: One descriptive response validation after reference/process choices freeze, no further parameter changes
evaluation.test: Generated only after source/model/config freeze and validation outputs saved; four paired seed blocks, 256 base tasks, 768 strong/weak/null variants
primary: cumulative and longest response duration error
secondary: onset and last-positive interval, with missing counts
evaluation.inference: Paired seed-block differences descriptive only; four seeds are not a precise scientific superiority or field-validation claim
limits: Bounded smooth natural charging mechanism; no natural-session stopping or actual departure/missing-window verification

stop: One fixed small reproduction. Keep negative results; no tuning on evaluation truth/test, no automatic formal adoption or CPOP replacement, no reports/other resources/B2/B3/B4/new dependencies/ZIP/UI/uploads/commits.
